metadata.description: Cong thuc xac suat va thong ke lop 12

formulas.name: probability_basic
formulas.description_vi: Xac suat cua bien co A bang so ket qua thuan loi chia cho tong so ket qua
formulas.description_en: Probability = favorable outcomes / total outcomes

formulas.name: probability_complement
formulas.description_vi: Xac suat bien co doi bang 1 tru xac suat bien co
formulas.description_en: Probability of complement = 1 - P(A)

formulas.name: probability_union
formulas.name_vi: Xac suat hop hai bien co
formulas.formula: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B)
formulas.description_vi: Xac suat hop hai bien co (cong thuc cong xac suat)
formulas.description_en: Addition rule: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B)
examples: P(A hoac B) khi A, B xung khac: P(A) + P(B)

formulas.name: probability_intersection_independent
formulas.name_vi: Xac suat giao hai bien co doc lap
formulas.description_vi: Xac suat giao hai bien co doc lap bang tich cac xac suat
formulas.description_en: For independent events: P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B)

formulas.name: probability_conditional
formulas.description_vi: Xac suat cua A khi biet B da xay ra
formulas.description_en: Conditional probability: P(A given B)
examples: P(do|bi do hoac xanh) = P(do) / P(do hoac xanh)

formulas.name: combination
formulas.description_vi: So cach chon k phan tu tu n phan tu (khong quan tam thu tu)
formulas.description_en: Combination: ways to choose k from n (order doesn't matter)

formulas.name: permutation
formulas.description_vi: So cach sap xep k phan tu tu n phan tu (quan tam thu tu)
formulas.description_en: Permutation: ways to arrange k from n (order matters)

formulas.name: factorial
formulas.description_vi: Giai thua cua n la tich cac so tu 1 den n
formulas.description_en: Factorial: product of integers from 1 to n

formulas.name: binomial_coefficient_property
formulas.name_vi: Tinh chat he so nhi thuc
formulas.description_vi: He so nhi thuc doi xung
formulas.description_en: Binomial coefficient symmetry

formulas.name: mean
formulas.description_vi: Trung binh cong la tong cac gia tri chia cho so luong
formulas.description_en: Arithmetic mean = sum of values / count

formulas.name: mean_frequency
formulas.description_vi: Trung binh khi co bang tan so, N = tong tan so
formulas.description_en: Weighted mean with frequencies
examples: Diem 7 co 5 nguoi, diem 8 co 3 nguoi: (7*5+8*3)/8 = 7.375

formulas.name: variance
formulas.description_vi: Phuong sai do muc do phan tan cua du lieu
formulas.description_en: Variance measures spread of data around mean

formulas.name: variance_formula_2
formulas.description_vi: Cong thuc tinh nhanh phuong sai
formulas.description_en: Alternative variance formula

formulas.name: standard_deviation
formulas.description_vi: Do lech chuan la can bac hai cua phuong sai
formulas.description_en: Standard deviation = square root of variance

formulas.name: median
formulas.formula: Me = x[(n+1)/2] neu n le, Me = (x[n/2] + x[n/2+1])/2 neu n chan
formulas.description_vi: Trung vi la gia tri o giua khi sap xep tang dan
formulas.description_en: Median is middle value when data is sorted

formulas.name: mode
formulas.formula: Mo = gia tri co tan so lon nhat
formulas.description_vi: Mot la gia tri xuat hien nhieu nhat trong tap du lieu
formulas.description_en: Mode is most frequent value

formulas.name: range
formulas.description_vi: Khoang bien thien la hieu gia tri lon nhat va nho nhat
formulas.description_en: Range = maximum - minimum

formulas.name: binomial_probability
formulas.description_vi: Xac suat dung k lan trong n lan thu doc lap
formulas.description_en: Binomial probability: k successes in n trials

formulas.name: binomial_expected_value
formulas.description_vi: Ky vong cua phan phoi nhi thuc
formulas.description_en: Expected value of binomial distribution
examples: Tung xu 100 lan: E(so lan sap) = 100 * 0.5 = 50

formulas.name: binomial_variance
formulas.description_vi: Phuong sai cua phan phoi nhi thuc
formulas.description_en: Variance of binomial distribution
